text: Could you create an ad for my fictional planning app DayNest, using simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green? I've been imagining how this little app might feel in an ad, and I'm a bit nervous about explaining the idea clearly. What I mean is that it should be silent, 9 seconds long in 16:9, with three equal-length scenes. The exact lines should be 'Less scrolling. More doing.' for the first scene, 'Plan your day in one place.' for the second, and 'Try DayNest today.' for the third, keeping the capitals and punctuation exactly as written. Please don't include any other visible words at all, even in the background.
